Q1: Which part of the repository should this issue change?
Choices:
A. The review/autofix pipeline (`review_autofix.yml` and its `scripts/review_*` helpers)
B. The orchestrator poller and judges (`orchestrate_poll.yml`, `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh`)
C. Clarify, plan or implement phase workflows and prompts
D. Documentation only (README, `docs/`, an `agents.d/` fragment)
E. Something else: name the file, workflow or feature in your answer (RECOMMENDED)
Q2: What problem should be fixed, and what result counts as "better"?
Choices:
A. A specific bug or failure: give the run, issue or PR link and the behaviour you expected (RECOMMENDED)
B. Performance or cost (runtime, API calls, model tokens): give the metric and the target
C. Reliability (fewer stalls, retries or `ai:needs-human` escalations): name the failure mode
D. Clearer docs or log output: name the section or log prefix
E. No concrete problem in mind yet: close this issue and file a specific one later
